The groups contain measurements at z = (0.51, 0.706, 0.934); (0.934, 1.321); (1.484, 2.33). The adopted prior is Ωm = 0.33 ± 0.01. The supernova data and comparison criteria are held fixed. The comparison tracks fit quality and the direction of the preference in dark-energy parameters. The families compared are red galaxies, emission-line galaxies and the quasar group with Lyman-alpha.

result.pt-BR: A direção da preferência por energia escura variável persistiu após a exclusão de cada grupo. O resultado demonstra robustez interna para os dados e agrupamentos examinados, sem estabelecer uma detecção global.
result.en: The direction of the preference for evolving dark energy persisted after each group was excluded. The result demonstrates internal robustness for the data and groupings examined, without establishing a global detection.
